$comment: Desktop npm audit baseline (audit PR-06 reviewed 2026-10-13 after the electron 33 -> 44.7.0 + electron-builder 25.1.8 -> 26.17.0 upgrade). Before the upgrade `npm audit` for desktop/ listed 19 entries (4 moderate / 14 high / 1 critical, critical was `tar`); the upgrade resolved all critical/high entries. The 8 remaining entries are all moderate and trace to a single root advisory, GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (sprintf-js DoS via unbounded precision specifiers): sprintf-js 1.1.3 is the latest npm release and no fixed version has been published upstream, so the whole roarr -> global-agent -> @electron/get chain (pulled in by electron itself and by app-builder-lib) stays affected until upstream ships a fix. This file is the waiver list consumed by scripts/check-npm-audit.js: any critical/high entry NOT listed here (or a new advisory id / severity escalation on a listed entry) fails the CI gate. Waivers expire on `until` -- an expired entry also fails the gate and forces re-review. Full rationale and links: docs/desktop-supply-chain-audit.md.
